capabilities: Publish notes to a Ghost blog from preset tabs
Triage and queue candidate notes by time range
Upload embedded images and rewrite them as Ghost image cards
Resolve wikilinks and upgrade YouTube and LINK blocks to cards
Skip unchanged notes using a SHA-256 body hash
disambiguation: Not Obsidian Publish; it sends notes to a Ghost blog through the Ghost Admin API.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The Admin API key is kept in Obsidian's device-local secret storage or read from the GHOST_ADMIN_KEY environment variable. A user guide and technical documentation are published on GitHub Pages.
problem: Moving notes from Obsidian to a Ghost blog means copying text by hand and re-uploading images, links, embeds, and footnotes.

relations.evidence: Publish your vault notes to a Ghost blog with configurable presets

summary: Publishes vault notes to a Ghost blog through configurable presets for tags, newsletters, status, and frontmatter keys.
